name: io.github.ryanbiddy/uoink
description: Uoink keeps videos, podcasts, and articles on your disk for AI search and citations. Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex CLI connect over MCP; ChatGPT and claude.ai use copy and paste.

install.notes: Unsigned installer, about 390 MB; no admin rights needed. Windows SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway. Then open the .mcpb bundle for one-click Claude Desktop setup, or copy the setup page’s stdio config.

transports.note: Every tool is available over stdio without the helper running. Use absolute paths; Claude Desktop does not expand %LOCALAPPDATA%. Cursor can use UOINK_MCP_TOOLSET=core for the previous 35-tool set under its reported 40-tool cap. Cline and Continue were not individually smoke-tested.
Local-only. Full tool registry. Token in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Uoink\token.txt. HTTP and stdio advertise the same flattened tool schemas; the server still validates the exact schema.
OpenAPI 3.1 bridge for local agents that do not speak MCP.

platform: Windows 10/11 only. No Mac build scheduled.
